## Description

Extend transcription and drafting to Arabic and Malayalam (and mixed AR/EN, ML/EN, HI/EN) with original and translation side by side in transcript and evidence; per-language evaluation sets.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Per-language evaluation sets meet the same safety gate (0 fabricated medicines/doses).
- [ ] **AC2.** Transcript and evidence show original-language text beside the translation for each language.
- [ ] **AC3.** Language quality results are documented per language before enabling it per tenant.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
